payload.title: [anthus-site-content] "Plexus" still appears in 21 places across ~10 articles and diagrams
payload.description:
**Problem**
The old product name "Plexus" remains in about 21 places in roughly 10 articles, including diagrams. The product is now Primus.

**Evidence**
Audit grep over anthus-site-content. Note that historical references may be intentional; decide per case.

**Fix**
Replace with "Primus" where it refers to the current product; leave dated historical mentions or annotate them. Regenerate diagrams.

**How to verify**
`grep -rni plexus content/ | wc -l` is 0 (or only intentional historical mentions).

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
